verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's own docs show multiple retrospective templates for standardizing reviews across incident types and teams (docs-9, docs-61, docs-78), plus a 'Draft with AI' feature that analyzes the incident timeline and details to draft a review (docs-13, docs-80, docs-35, docs-45). Collaborative editing with live presence (enterprise-only) and permission requirements give only partial support for a review step (docs-10, docs-62), and nothing documents a publication step. Missing for 10: a documented review/approval workflow, a documented publication or sharing step for finished postmortems, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
